theory.intro: To find a perimeter, you need to know the length of every side around the shape. Equal sides do not all need separate measurements. Use the shape or matching marks to find the unlabelled side lengths, then add all the outside lengths.
facts: A **rectangle** or **parallelogram** has equal opposite sides. One measurement from each pair gives all four side lengths.
A **square**, **rhombus** or **regular polygon** has equal sides. One side measurement gives all the side lengths.
Matching marks show equal lengths. Sides with the same marks have the same length.
Perimeter includes only the outside edges. An internal height or diagonal is not part of the perimeter.
steps: Identify the shape and the given equal-side information.
Use equal sides to find the unlabelled outside lengths.
Add all the outside lengths and state the perimeter.

workedExamples.question_text:
(a) Find the perimeter of a rhombus with side length $8\text{ cm}$.
(b) Find the perimeter of a regular hexagon with side length $3\text{ cm}$.
workedExamples.solution_text:
**Identify the shape and the given equal-side information.**
(a) A rhombus has four equal sides. (b) A regular hexagon has six equal sides.

**Use equal sides to find the unlabelled outside lengths.**
(a) Each side is $8\text{ cm}$. (b) Each side is $3\text{ cm}$.

**Add all the outside lengths and state the perimeter.**
(a) $P=4\times8=32\text{ cm}$. (b) $P=6\times3=18\text{ cm}$.

workedExamples.question_text:
(a) Find the perimeter of a rectangle with length $9\text{ cm}$ and width $4\text{ cm}$.
(b) Find the perimeter of an isosceles triangle with base $6\text{ cm}$ and equal sides of $5\text{ cm}$.
workedExamples.solution_text:
**Identify the shape and the given equal-side information.**
(a) Opposite rectangle sides are equal. (b) The two sloping triangle sides are equal.

**Use equal sides to find the unlabelled outside lengths.**
(a) The sides are $9\text{ cm}$, $4\text{ cm}$, $9\text{ cm}$ and $4\text{ cm}$. (b) The sides are $6\text{ cm}$, $5\text{ cm}$ and $5\text{ cm}$.

**Add all the outside lengths and state the perimeter.**
(a) $P=2\times9+2\times4=26\text{ cm}$. (b) $P=6+2\times5=16\text{ cm}$.

workedExamples.question_text: Find the perimeter of a quadrilateral with side lengths $4\text{ m}$, $6\text{ m}$, $8\text{ m}$ and $5\text{ m}$.
workedExamples.solution_text:
**Identify the shape and the given equal-side information.**
All four outside lengths are given.

**Use equal sides to find the unlabelled outside lengths.**
There are no unlabelled outside lengths to find.

**Add all the outside lengths and state the perimeter.**
$P=4+6+8+5=23\text{ m}$.

workedExamples.question_text: Find the perimeter of a parallelogram with sides $14\text{ cm}$ and $9\text{ cm}$. Its internal perpendicular height is $7\text{ cm}$.
workedExamples.solution_text:
**Identify the shape and the given equal-side information.**
Opposite sides of the parallelogram are equal.

**Use equal sides to find the unlabelled outside lengths.**
The outside lengths are $14\text{ cm}$, $9\text{ cm}$, $14\text{ cm}$ and $9\text{ cm}$. The internal height is not an outside edge.

**Add all the outside lengths and state the perimeter.**
$P=2\times14+2\times9=46\text{ cm}$.

foundation.question_text: Calculate the perimeter of a rectangle with length $7\text{ cm}$ and width $3\text{ cm}$.
foundation.solution_text: Opposite sides are equal, so the sides are $7\text{ cm}$, $3\text{ cm}$, $7\text{ cm}$ and $3\text{ cm}$. $P=2\times7+2\times3=20\text{ cm}$.

foundation.question_text: Calculate the perimeter of a square with side length $9\text{ m}$. Use multiplication for repeated addition.
foundation.solution_text: All four sides are $9\text{ m}$. $P=4\times9=36\text{ m}$.

foundation.question_text: Calculate the perimeter of a triangle with side lengths $4\text{ cm}$, $6\text{ cm}$ and $8\text{ cm}$.
foundation.solution_text: Add all three outside lengths. $P=4+6+8=18\text{ cm}$.

foundation.question_text: Calculate the perimeter of a rhombus with side length $12\text{ cm}$. Its internal diagonal is $8\text{ cm}$.
foundation.solution_text: All four outside sides are $12\text{ cm}$. The internal diagonal is not part of the perimeter. $P=4\times12=48\text{ cm}$.

foundation.question_text: Calculate the perimeter of a parallelogram with sides $11\text{ cm}$ and $6\text{ cm}$. Its internal perpendicular height is $5\text{ cm}$.
foundation.solution_text: Opposite sides are equal. The internal height is not part of the perimeter. $P=2\times11+2\times6=34\text{ cm}$.

foundation.question_text: Calculate the perimeter of a quadrilateral with side lengths $6\text{ m}$, $8\text{ m}$, $11\text{ m}$ and $7\text{ m}$.
foundation.solution_text: Add all four outside lengths. $P=6+8+11+7=32\text{ m}$.

development.question_text: Calculate the perimeter of a rectangle with length $12.4\text{ cm}$ and width $5.6\text{ cm}$.
Calculate the perimeter of a square with side length $2.7\text{ m}$.
development.solution_text: All four sides are equal. $P=4\times2.7=10.8\text{ m}$.

development.question_text: Calculate the perimeter of an isosceles triangle with base $7.4\text{ cm}$ and equal sloping sides of $6.8\text{ cm}$.
development.solution_text: Both sloping sides are $6.8\text{ cm}$. $P=7.4+2\times6.8=21\text{ cm}$.

development.question_text: Calculate the perimeter of a regular hexagon with side length $2.4\text{ cm}$.
development.solution_text: All six sides are $2.4\text{ cm}$. $P=6\times2.4=14.4\text{ cm}$.

development.question_text: Calculate the perimeter of a rectangle with length $13.7\text{ m}$ and width $8.3\text{ m}$.
Calculate the perimeter of a rhombus with side length $7.6\text{ cm}$. Its internal diagonal is $9\text{ cm}$.
development.solution_text: All four outside sides are $7.6\text{ cm}$. Do not include the internal diagonal. $P=4\times7.6=30.4\text{ cm}$.

mastery.question_text: Calculate the perimeter of a parallelogram with sides $18.75\text{ cm}$ and $12.45\text{ cm}$. Its internal perpendicular height is $10.2\text{ cm}$.
mastery.solution_text: Opposite sides are equal. The internal height is not part of the perimeter. $P=2\times18.75+2\times12.45=62.4\text{ cm}$.

mastery.question_text: Calculate the perimeter of a regular hexagon with side length $3.75\text{ cm}$.
mastery.solution_text: All six sides are $3.75\text{ cm}$. $P=6\times3.75=22.5\text{ cm}$.

mastery.question_text: Calculate the perimeter of a rhombus with side length $16.85\text{ cm}$. Its internal diagonal is $21.4\text{ cm}$.
mastery.solution_text: All four outside sides are $16.85\text{ cm}$. The internal diagonal is not part of the perimeter. $P=4\times16.85=67.4\text{ cm}$.
